Student hub

It’s Postgraduate Welcome week

Whether you’re new to Sheffield or continuing your postgraduate journey, there are socials, activities and events to help you connect with other PGT and PGR students taking place throughout the week.

Find out what’s on

Part-time Jobs Fair

Join us in the Octagon on Wednesday 7 October to meet local employers offering part-time jobs in various sectors, including charities, retail, STEM, and more.

Influence learning and teaching at the University

Play an active role in shaping learning and teaching by collaborating with academics and offering feedback on their practice and how they work with students.

World Mental Health Day - 7 October

Check in with yourself and connect with others this World Mental Health Day. No matter how you’re feeling, drop by the SU on 7 October to create something, write a message to your future self, or discover university support services.
